description: Every GPU of every cluster node, from its dcgm-exporter. Adapted from NVIDIA dcgm-exporter's dashboard (Apache-2.0): a partition filter, nodes by name.

panels.title: GPU jobs now
panels.description: Running Slurm jobs, what they were allocated and what they use, from the Slurm job pusher (services/slurm-exporter); only the jobs its account can see. CPU % is busy cores over allocated CPUs; RAM % is memory in use over memory requested.

targets.expr: max by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (slurm_job_cpus{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"})
count by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"})

avg by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL * on (instance, gpu) group_left (job_id, user, job_name, partition) slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"})

sum by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED * on (instance, gpu) group_left (job_id, user, job_name, partition) slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"}) / 1024

100 * sum by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED * on (instance, gpu) group_left (job_id, user, job_name, partition) slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"}) / sum by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) ((DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE) * on (instance, gpu) group_left (job_id, user, job_name, partition) slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"})

100 * sum by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[2m]) * on (instance, cpu) group_left (job_id, user, job_name, partition) slurm_job_cpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"}) / on (job_id, user, job_name, partition) max by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (slurm_job_cpus{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"})
max by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (slurm_job_rss_bytes{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"}) / 2^30

100 * max by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (slurm_job_rss_bytes{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"}) / on (job_id, user, job_name, partition) max by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (slurm_job_memory_bytes{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"} > 0)

panels.title: Pusher last push
panels.description: Seconds since the Slurm job pusher last pushed; over a minute means it stopped and the jobs above are what it last saw.

targets.expr: avg by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL * on (instance, gpu) group_left (job_id, user, job_name, partition) slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"})

sum by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED * on (instance, gpu) group_left (job_id, user, job_name, partition) slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"}) * 1024 * 1024

panels.title: Holding GPUs but nearly idle (under 5% for 15 min)
panels.description: Jobs whose GPUs averaged under 5% utilisation over the last 15 minutes: candidates to check or release.

targets.expr: avg by (job_id, user, job_name, partition) (avg_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL[15m]) * on (instance, gpu) group_left (job_id, user, job_name, partition) slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"}) < 5

panels.title: Each GPU now
panels.description: Every GPU of the selected partitions with its utilisation and memory, and the job holding it (blank: no job the pusher can see).

targets.expr: label_join(max by (instance, gpu, job_id, user, job_name) ((DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition"} * on (instance, gpu) group_left (job_id, user, job_name) slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs"}) or on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{partition=~"$partition"}), "slot", "/", "instance", "gpu")

label_join(max by (instance, gpu, job_id, user, job_name) ((DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{partition=~"$partition"} * on (instance, gpu) group_left (job_id, user, job_name) slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs"}) or on (instance, gpu) DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{partition=~"$partition"}) / 1024, "slot", "/", "instance", "gpu")

panels.title: Each node now
panels.description: Per node: CPU busy and RAM in use (node_exporter), GPU utilisation and VRAM (dcgm-exporter), and how many of its GPUs jobs hold.

panels.title: By user now
panels.description: Per user, summed over their running jobs (those the Slurm job pusher can see): what they hold and use.

targets.expr: count by (user) (group by (user, job_id) ({__name__=~"slurm_job_gpu|slurm_job_cpus", job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"}))
avg by (user) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL * on (instance, gpu) group_left (user) slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"})
sum by (user) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED * on (instance, gpu) group_left (user) slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"}) / 1024

100 * sum by (user) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[2m]) * on (instance, cpu) group_left (user) slurm_job_cpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"}) / on (user) sum by (user) (slurm_job_cpus{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"})

100 * sum by (user) (slurm_job_rss_bytes{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"}) / on (user) sum by (user) (slurm_job_memory_bytes{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"} > 0)

panels.title: GPU-hours by user (time range)
panels.description: Over the dashboard's time range, sampled every 5 minutes: GPU-hours held, GPU-hours busy (held x utilisation), and the busy share. Only time the pusher was running counts.

targets.expr: sum_over_time(sum by (user) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL * on (instance, gpu) group_left (user) slurm_job_gpu{job="slurm_jobs", partition=~"$partition", user=~"$user"} / 100)[$__range:5m]) / 12

title: GPU nodes
